Bearer.description: User session, configured machine token or a dts_pat_ personal token. Personal tokens require this header and are excluded from WebSocket, worker writes, session management and OIDC-only mode.

info.description: Generated from the server's HTTP routes and Go wire types. Authenticated requests use a configured role token or login session. Cookie-authenticated writes require a matching Origin and X-DTS-Browser: 1. Worker POST routes use the worker credential when configured and otherwise use normal user authorization.
